mentions.name: Ferrite
mentions.description: Native Markdown editor built in Rust with egui that also handles JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV. Offers raw, split and WYSIWYG modes, [[wikilinks]] with a backlinks panel, native Mermaid rendering, and Vim mode, while making no network calls and keeping large files light. Runs on Windows and Linux (Flathub, AUR, deb/rpm) with experimental macOS support, is MIT licensed, and all code is AI-generated with the author doing direction, testing and review.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ferrite ([github.com/OlaProeis/Ferrite](https://github.com/OlaProeis/Ferrite)), a native Markdown editor I'm building in Rust + egui. It also handles JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV. It has raw, split and WYSIWYG modes, [[wikilinks]] with a backlinks panel, native Mermaid rendering and Vim mode, and it makes no network calls.
mentions.author: OlaProis
